creators: Bao-Zhu Guan, Xiang-Hong Liu, Zhao-Hui Lai
description:
Version 1.0.0. Workflow entry accompanying the manuscript "Specificity-testing gene-set associations in epilepsy transcriptomics: a calibrated permutation pipeline and reporting standard" (GigaScience, submitted).

## What the workflow does
1. Differential expression - limma 3.68.4 / edgeR 4.10.1, moderated t, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR < 0.05.
2. Label-permutation calibration - 200 permutations of group labels, re-running normalisation and the linear model.
3. Expression-matched null - genes ranked by average expression into 20 strata; 2,000 null replicates; Z = (observed - mean(null)) / sd(null).
4. Composition adjustment - six marker-based cell-type scores plus tissue source, as a four-model ladder.
5. Calibration probes - cell-type marker sets must survive the same FDR correction as the candidate gene sets.
6. Null-model comparison - expression-matched, naive hypergeometric, camera and fry on identical data.
7. Detection threshold - spiked-in simulation (7 magnitudes x 30 replicates) plus the analytic minimum detectable enrichment.

## Inputs
Four public GEO series: GSE256068, GSE213488, GSE128300, GSE272142 (148 samples in total).

## Environment
R 4.6.1 (limma 3.68.4, edgeR 4.10.1, Bioconductor 3.23), Python 3.12. Random seed 20260922.

Archived code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23878329
Intermediate results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23878316
name: Specificity-testing pipeline for gene-set inference in disease transcriptomics
